sentences.en: PAUL: Hello, Kira, how are you?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 你好，基拉，最近怎么样？

sentences.en: KIRA: Fine thanks, Paul, how are you?
sentences.zh: KIRA: 很好，谢谢，保罗，你呢？

sentences.en: PAUL: Well, thanks.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我也很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: It's good to see you.
sentences.zh: 见到你真高兴。

sentences.en: It must be twelve months since you did our course?
sentences.zh: 距你参加我们的课程应该已经有一年了吧？

sentences.en: KIRA: That's right.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 没错。

sentences.en: It's nice to come back and say hello.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回来打个招呼。

sentences.en: PAUL: What course did you enrol in?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 当初你报的是哪门课程？

sentences.en: KIRA: Actually, went straight into third year Pharmacy.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 实际上，我直接进入了药学专业三年级。

sentences.en: They credited me with two years, which probably made it more difficult for me.
sentences.zh: 学校给了我两年的学分认定，但这可能反而让我更难适应了。

sentences.en: PAUL: On the other hand, you were lucky to be granted credits.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 另一方面，你能获得学分认定也算幸运。

sentences.en: Is that why you chose the course?
sentences.zh: 所以你选择这门课程就是这个原因吗？

sentences.en: KIRA: Yes.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 是的。

sentences.en: And, as I'd already finished a course in it in my country, I thought it would be easier if I studied something I already knew.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于我在自己国家已修完相关课程，我觉得学习自己已有基础的内容会更容易些。

sentences.en: PAUL: I didn't realise you went into third year.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我之前并不知道你直接进了三年级。

sentences.en: I thought you started in first year.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你是从一年级开始读的。

sentences.en: No wonder it was so hard!
sentences.zh: 怪不得那么难！

sentences.en: And what do you think is one of the big differences between studying at a university here and studying in your country?
sentences.zh: 那么，你觉得在这里的大学学习与在自己国家学习，最大的区别之一是什么？

sentences.en: KIRA: it Well, I've found it very difficult to write assignments, because wasn't familiar with that aspect of the system here.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 嗯，我发现写作业特别困难，因为对这里的这一教学环节不太熟悉。

sentences.en: The main problem is that the lecturers expect you to be critical.
sentences.zh: 主要问题在于，讲师们期望学生具备批判性思维。

sentences.en: That made me feel really terrible.
sentences.zh: 这让我感觉非常糟糕。

sentences.en: I thought "How can I possibly do it?
sentences.zh: 我当时想：‘我怎么可能做到呢？’

sentences.en: How can I comment on someone else's research when they probably spent five years doing it?" I think a lot of people who come from overseas countries have similar problems.
sentences.zh: ‘当别人花了五年时间做一项研究时，我怎么能去评论他们的成果呢？’我觉得很多来自海外国家的学生都有类似的问题。

sentences.en: But after a while it became easier for me.
sentences.zh: 但过了一段时间后，我就逐渐适应了。

sentences.en: People expect you to have problems with the process of reading and writing but, in fact, it is more a question of altering your viewpoint towards academic study.
sentences.zh: 人们通常认为你在阅读和写作方面会遇到困难，但实际上，更关键的是要调整自己对学术学习的态度和视角。

sentences.en: PAUL: How was the content of the lectures?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 那么讲座内容怎么样？

sentences.en: Was it easy for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说容易理解吗？

sentences.en: KIRA: I didn't really have many problems understanding lectures.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 我听讲座其实没遇到太多理解上的问题。

sentences.en: The content was very similar to what I'd studied before.
sentences.zh: 讲座内容与我之前学过的非常相似。

sentences.en: PAUL: And what about the lecturers themselves?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 那讲师本人呢？

sentences.en: Are they essentially the same as lecturers in your country?
sentences.zh: 他们和你本国的讲师本质上一样吗？

sentences.en: KIRA: Well actually, no.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 嗯，实际上并不一样。

sentences.en: Here, they're much easier to approach.
sentences.zh: 这里的讲师要容易接触得多。

sentences.en: After every lecture you can go and ask them something you didn't understand.
sentences.zh: 每次讲座结束后，你都可以去找他们询问自己没听懂的地方。

sentences.en: Or you can make an appointment and talk to them about anything in the course.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以预约时间，就课程中的任何问题与他们交流。

sentences.en: PAUL: Maybe you found them different because you're a more mature student now, whereas when you were studying in your country you were younger and not so assertive.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 或许你觉得他们不同，是因为你现在是一名更成熟的学员，而以前在自己国家读书时年纪更小、也不那么主动自信。

sentences.en: KIRA: No, I don't think that's the difference.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 不，我不认为这是差异所在。

sentences.en: Most of the students here do it.
sentences.zh: 这里大多数学生都会这么做。

sentences.en: In my faculty, they all seem to make appointments - usually to talk about something in the course that's worrying them, but sometimes just about something that might really interest them, something they might want to specialise in.
sentences.zh: 在我所在的院系，学生们似乎都会预约——通常是为讨论课程中令他们担忧的内容，但有时也纯粹是为了探讨自己真正感兴趣、甚至希望将来专攻的某个方向。

sentences.en: The lecturers must set aside certain times every week when they're available for students.
sentences.zh: 讲师们每周必须专门留出固定时段供学生咨询。

sentences.en: PAUL: That's good to hear.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 听到这个消息真好。

sentences.en: PAUL: And how was your timetable?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 那么，你的课表情况如何？

sentences.en: Was it a very busy year?
sentences.zh: 这一年是不是非常忙碌？

sentences.en: KIRA: Very, very busy.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 非常、非常忙碌。

sentences.en: They make you work very hard.
sentences.zh: 他们要求你非常刻苦地学习。

sentences.en: Apart from lectures, we had practical sessions in a lot of subjects.
sentences.zh: 除了讲座之外，我们在许多科目中还安排了实践课程。

sentences.en: We did these in small groups.
sentences.zh: 这些实践课是以小组形式进行的。

sentences.en: had to go and work four hours every week in a community pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 每周必须前往一家社区药房工作四小时。

sentences.en: Actually, I enjoyed this very much - meeting new people all the time.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我非常喜欢这部分——总是能结识新朋友。

sentences.en: Then www.TopSage.com Tapescripts in second semester, we had to a step/into /a/wounded molodor1514-189 every second day we went to one of the big hospitals and worked there.
sentences.zh: 然后，在第二学期，我们每隔一天就要去一家大型医院实习。

sentences.en: And on top of all that we had our assignments, which took me a lot of C.com time.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我们还有各种作业，占用了我大量时间。

sentences.en: Oh, nearly forgot, between first and second semesters, we had to work full-time for two weeks in a hospital.
sentences.zh: 哦，差点忘了，第一和第二学期之间，我们还要在一家医院全职工作两周。

sentences.en: PAUL: That does sound a very heavy year.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 听起来这确实是非常繁重的一年。

sentences.en: So are you pleased now that you did it?
sentences.zh: 那么，你现在是否为自己当初选择了这条路而感到高兴呢？

sentences.en: Do you feel some sense of achievement?
sentences.zh: 你是否有一种成就感？

sentences.en: KIRA: Yeah, do feel much more confident, which suppose is the most important thing.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 是的，我确实感觉自信多了，我想这或许是最重要的一点。

sentences.en: PAUL: And have you got any recommendations for people who are studying from overseas?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 对于那些从海外来此求学的学生，你有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: KIRA: Well, I suppose they need very good English.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 嗯，我想他们需要具备非常扎实的英语能力。

sentences.en: It would be much better if they spent more time learning English before they enter the university, because you can be in big trouble if you don't understand what people are saying and you haven't got time to translate.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在进入大学前能花更多时间学习英语，情况会好得多；因为如果你听不懂别人在说什么，又没有时间去翻译，就会陷入很大的困境。

sentences.en: PAUL: Anything else?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 还有别的建议吗？

sentences.en: KIRA: Well, as I said before, the biggest problem for me was a lack of familiarity with the education system here.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 嗯，正如我之前所说，对我来说最大的难题就是对这里的教育体系缺乏了解。

sentences.en: PAUL: It sounds as if it was a real challenge.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 听起来这的确是一次真正的挑战。

sentences.en: Congratulations, Kira.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你，基拉。

sentences.en: KIRA: Thanks, Paul.
sentences.zh: KIRA: 谢谢你，保罗。
